name: Timecode
description: Tick marks with a long one every fifth frame, running like a timecode strip along the edge of film.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 44%; top: 32%; width: 12%; height: 36%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@x % 5 == 1) { :after { top: 8%; height: 84%; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
